text.en: Believes the p-value is the probability that the null hypothesis is true, rather than the probability of seeing a test statistic at least this extreme if the null hypothesis were true.
text.et: Arvab, et olulisustõenäosus (p-väärtus) on tõenäosus, et nullhüpotees on tõene, mitte tõenäosus näha vähemalt nii äärmuslikku teststatistikut, kui nullhüpotees kehtiks.
